verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy: the '20% off' headline has shrunk to small body-text size, while the supporting copy is now larger and floats over the peach circle to the right. The CTA sits in the middle of the canvas, and the left column, centre button and right copy share no alignment, so the layout reads as scattered fragments. B keeps the original's structure, hierarchy and colours with a clean left-aligned column; it only needs minor polish, since the stack is a bit tight vertically and the Shop Sale button sits close to the bottom edge.
